'''Tayshin Maxa''' was a [[human]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> [[Gender|female]] who served as a member of the [[Cloud-Riders]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Solo" /> After the [[Droid Gotra]] caused a gang dispute on the [[planet]] [[Eshan]], Maxa learned to survive on her own and imparted her survival lessons to her younger sister [[Moda Maxa]]. Maxa wore a repurposed [[ASP-2]] [[droid]] faceplate as a [[helmet]]. She typically paired with [[Baroosh Pawk]] on raids, piloting a [[Caelli-Merced]] [[Halberd-441]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:TayshinMaxa-SoloTOG.png|thumb|left|200px|Tayshin Maxa was a highly skilled in Echani]]
Tayshin Maxa was a human<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> female with [[Color|red]] [[hair]] and tan skin.<ref name="Card Trader" /> Maxa was protective of her sister Moda and uneasily suspected that [[Callixido Ryss]]'s antics and tendency to challenge her sister to races during raids were a sign of his attraction towards her.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Maxa was a skilled [[Echani (martial art)|martial artist]] and trained with Moda to improve their combat skills. Although Tayshin Maxa was the more skilled martial artist, her sister was the superior [[pilot]] of the two.

==Behind the scenes==
Tayshin Maxa first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
